b:
They were
the messengers of hell
in my school days

In the seven seconds
it took
to pass
the classroom balcony
you could kiss death itself

The titles
I earned
without studying
would fall
in those
few seconds
like a spray of spit

Today
I am somewhere
in a corner
of their memory

Every day
they are
the vultures
of my graveyard memories

Many answered
my outbursts
in a single line:
"This is
survival of the fittest"

If so,
I have survived;
my mind
has died

Stand
in my
shoes
and see

No!
They fit
only
me

Your seconds of joy
are still,
to this day,
nerunji thorns inside me

Do not smear
this filth
on tomorrow's generation

Even in front of them
I can only
put on a mask
and stand
apart

How to talk back
I forgot
long ago
note: Nerunji (puncture vine) is a creeper whose small, hard thorns lie hidden in the grass and pierce bare feet.
